current_mission: Physically measure the diagnostic-only Beta 15.97 speedup and use its new worksheet substages to choose the next orange-iPad bottleneck without weakening recognition or geometry.
north_star: Primary students scan completed worksheets on shared iPads; teachers review saved results only when needed.
next_best_move: Run one Beta 15.97 Debug Scan of P08 on the orange iPad, time capture to result, and manually Export before correcting. Compare worksheetStageTrace to the Beta 15.95 22.021-second aggregate; do not optimize another substage until the physical trace identifies it.
plain_english_status: Orange-iPad automatic grading remains physically verified: Beta 15.95 again used ONNX.js WebGL, made five automatic decisions, and routed only Q6 to yellow review. Its result-ready time was 35.214 seconds, including a 22.021-second aggregate worksheet-processing stage. Beta 15.97 replaces a debug-only 1.5-million-call marker-image loop with one bulk OpenCV canvas transfer; modern Chromium/WebKit measured 2.4x/3.1x faster rasterization with identical PNG bytes and zero pixel mismatches. A preserved physical worksheet still replayed 8/8. New passive substages separately time marker detection, orientation selection, box registration, and tensor preparation. Recognition, homography, confidence, grading, and modern layout are unchanged; all 476 tests pass. Physical orange-iPad speed improvement is not yet claimed.

Expected leading 1s remain a major failure family; broad answer-key correction is unsafe because some students really write wrong answers.

cards.title: Decide separate-cell direction
cards.summary: The synthetic-authentic bakeoff gives separate cells a small edge, but not a market-readiness breakthrough.
cards.detail: Result folder: private-evidence/reports/answer-box-bakeoff-synthetic-20260704. Separate cells scored 131/186 filled digits and 70/120 exact questions, versus joined/open-divider at 129/186 filled digits and 68/120 exact questions. Blank slots were 54/54 clean for both. Use this to guide future worksheet design, not as proof of September classroom performance.

cards.title: Hold extra packets for validation

cards.detail: If more scans are requested later, keep the raw scan before manual corrections and note device/build/page type.

cards.title: Improve digit-model robustness next
cards.summary: The answer-box bakeoff suggests the box format is not the main remaining limiter.
cards.detail: Separate cells are likely the cleaner future format, but the larger reliability gap is handwritten digit recognition and review flow. Next technical work should focus on model robustness for primary handwriting and preserving near-zero confident wrong reads.

cards.title: Do not tune OCR blind
cards.summary: OCR/capture changes should wait for real sample evidence or a reproducible failing test.
cards.detail: This protects the currently promising MacBook/upload behavior and avoids overfitting to imagined problems.

cards.title: Decide pilot threshold
cards.summary: After real samples are tested, decide what is good enough for a small classroom pilot.
cards.detail: This should be based on scan success rate, retry behavior, and teacher-review usefulness.

cards.title: Old iPad engine fallback candidate verified
cards.summary: Build 2026.06.07-1745-EDT-sg3-old-ipad-engine-fallback protects good old-iPad captures from failing only because the auxiliary digit engine path did not load.
cards.detail: Production changes: Student Mode warms the digit model when capture starts, model initialization shares one in-flight promise, and right-slot model load/run failure falls back to the primary digit model instead of producing a whole-scan error. Verification: forced missing right-slot model replay produced 20 predictions and debug fallback metadata with no OCR error; npm run build passed; Playwright smoke/upload suite passed 5/5; clean 9-photo truth score stayed 89/90 confident, 89/89 confident accuracy, 0 confident wrong, and 90/90 all-answer OCR truth; older live iPhone replay stayed safe at 53/90 confident, 53/53 confident accuracy, and 0 confident wrong.

cards.title: Old iPad primary-engine fallback candidate verified

cards.detail: Forced missing primary model replay failed before the patch and produced no fatal OCR error after the patch: questionCorrect null, questionReviewCount 10, 20/20 review-needed predictions, digitEngineFallback true, and forcedFallbackReviewReason digit-engine-unavailable-review. cards.title: SG3 sharp auto-capture candidate verified

cards.title: Confidence calibration report added
cards.summary: SG3 now has a repeatable report showing why the app is under-confident and why broad threshold loosening is not enough.
cards.detail: Report: private-evidence/sg3-9-photo-confidence-20260606/candidate-four-from-one-rescues/confidence-calibration.md. It shows 41 reviewed answers, all 41 reviewed answers OCR-correct, and a target requirement of 86/90 confident reads. Moderate confidence-only promotion reaches 54/90; evidence-only reason promotion plus moderate no-reason mismatch reaches 88/90 but is not yet a safe production policy because it would trust fragile low-probability rescues.
